author: ieatboogers
text_post: I wouldn't rule out the paid sites out of hand, if I were you. They have one advantage over free sites, but it's a big one: even a nominal fee will weed out a lot of the clutter. Consider how many complaints about fake profiles there are. I can only guess at how many fake profiles are deliberately planted by the site to entice users, but I'd bet that if you're dealing with a reputable site, the number is low. A lot of these fake profiles are being posted by ordinary spammers, scammers, researchers, prostitutes, or people who want to be able to say "My fake profile got eighty messages in the first hour, what chance do I have?!" Some people will still do this anyway, but even a small monthly fee is going to be a deterrent to many, while it costs them nothing to do it on a free site. Of the real women on the sites, one can assume that if they are willing to incur a cost to join the site, there's a good chance they're actually serious about meeting someone. If she's just going to look for an ego boost, it costs her nothing to do it on a free site. And then there's the men. What assurance do you have that your competition isn't posting several different profiles with different personalities, maybe different vital statistics and pictures as well, just to try the grape shot approach? This will quickly drive up his costs on a paid site, but it costs him five times nothing on a free site. I think these advantages make the paid sites worth a look, so long as you stick to reputable sites and check carefully for two important things - that you can view as many profiles and read and write as many messages as you want with no additional charges above your monthly fee, and that you can cancel as easily as you joined!
